justification: The assessment returned verdict VALID (flawed_step and counterexample empty). Grading rubric: VALID or CANNOT_DECIDE => MISSED. Notably it did identify the exact ground-truth defect in prose -- the false universal claim at lines 0033-0034 that 'any set of n distinct vertices of G must include all the original vertices V_H', and even gave a matching-style witness ({v1,u1,u2} for n=3, cf. ground truth's {a,u1} for n=2) -- but it classified this as a non-fatal blemish and declined to report INVALID. Since the reported verdict is VALID, this is MISSED, not CAUGHT_MATCHING.
